json.title: Docs example passes max_concurrency inside configurable, where it is silently ignored
json.body:
Reproduction Steps / Example Code (Python)
import asyncio
import operator
from typing import Annotated, TypedDict

from langgraph.graph import START, StateGraph
from langgraph.types import Send

running = 0
peak = 0


class State(TypedDict):
    out: Annotated[list, operator.add]


async def work(payload):
    global running, peak
    running += 1
    peak = max(peak, running)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    running -= 1
    return {"out": [payload["i"]]}


builder = StateGraph(State)
builder.add_node("start", lambda state: {})
builder.add_node("work", work)
builder.add_edge(START, "start")
builder.add_conditional_edges("start", lambda state: [Send("work", {"i": i}) for i in range(40)], ["work"])
graph = builder.compile()

for label, config in (
    ("top-level", {"max_concurrency": 4}),
    ("inside configurable (as in the docs)", {"configurable": {"max_concurrency": 4}}),
    ("not set", {}),
):
    peak = 0
    asyncio.run(graph.ainvoke({"out": []}, config))
    print(f"{label:<38} peak concurrent tasks = {peak}")
Error Message and Stack Trace (if applicable)
No error. Output:

top-level                              peak concurrent tasks = 4
inside configurable (as in the docs)   peak concurrent tasks = 40
not set                                peak concurrent tasks = 40

Description:

The "Set max concurrency" tip on the Use the Graph API page (https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/use-graph-api) says:

You can control the maximum number of concurrent tasks by setting max_concurrency in the configuration when invoking the graph.

and shows:

graph.invoke({"value_1": "c"}, {"configurable": {"max_concurrency": 10}})
On langgraph 1.2.11, max_concurrency placed inside configurable has no effect: a Send fan-out runs with the same peak concurrency as when the key is not set at all. The same key at the top level of the config works as expected. No warning or error is raised for the ignored placement.

The Graph API page already warns that recursion_limit "is a standalone config key and should not be passed inside the configurable key", but the max_concurrency tip does the opposite.

System Info
langgraph 1.2.11
langchain-core 1.6.2
Python 3.13.9
Windows 11
